title: Zesty Indulgent German Peach Casserole
description: A fermented, gooey, and indulgent German dish featuring peach juice and bhuna, perfect for ovo-vegetarian diets. This casserole is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the peach juice, bhuna sauce, and sugar until well combined.
Add the sauerkraut, eggs, and flour to the bowl, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and dot the top with melted butter.
Bake the casserole for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole warm, garnished with additional sauerkraut and peach slices if desired.
